name: Fairmont Peace Hotel
insider_take: This legendary Art Deco masterpiece has been Shanghai's most prestigious address since 1929, where jazz legends once played and world leaders still stay.
whats_special: The Fairmont Peace Hotel is housed in the historic Sassoon House, once known as the "Cathay Hotel" - Asia's most luxurious hotel in the 1930s. The building's distinctive green copper pyramid roof has been a Bund landmark for nearly a century. Charlie Chaplin, George Bernard Shaw, and countless dignitaries have walked these halls, and the original 1930s elevator still operates today.
pro_tip: Book a Bund-facing room on floors 8-12 for the most spectacular views of Pudong's skyline. The hotel's Dragon Phoenix Restaurant serves the same menu that once delighted 1930s socialites.
dont_miss: The Peace Hall with its stunning stained-glass ceiling and original terrazzo floors, plus drinks at the rooftop bar overlooking the Huangpu River. The hotel's Jazz Bar features live performances honoring the venue's musical heritage where the Old Jazz Band once entertained Shanghai's elite.
pros: Historic landmark property with 1920s Art Deco architecture and rich heritage
Prime location on The Bund with stunning Huangpu River and Pudong skyline views
Exceptional luxury amenities including world-class spa and fine dining restaurants
Elegant rooms and suites with classic Shanghai glamour and modern comfort
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and prime Bund location
Historic building may have smaller room sizes compared to modern hotels
